snippet.title: Completely REMAKING My Bloons Tower Defense Game!
snippet.description:
I Completely RE-MADE Bloons Tower Defense, But YOU'RE The Bloon, and added tons of features like new maps, bloon upgrades and released the game!

Note, this is a FAN-MADE project, I have no affiliation with ninja kiwi. Don't sue me pls :) 

Play the game:
https://braianstrak.itch.io/bloons-but-youre-the-bloon

Join the community on discord!
https://discord.gg/k5HAcrBVe4

Art Contest Winners:
Trinity (Server invite banner and role icons):
Youtube - https://www.youtube.com/@Trinity-

In-Game Soundtrack/Theme:
Created by my boi Rough Sleeper, follow him on:
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/rough_sleeper_dnb/
Twitter - https://mobile.twitter.com/rough_sleep_dnb
Bandcamp - https://roughsleepermusic.bandcamp.com/

Music Used In Video:
Flashes by mezhdunami. https://soundcloud.com/mezhdunami
Creative Commons — Attribution 3.0 Unported — CC BY 3.0
Free Download / Stream: https://bit.ly/3tVJtCn
Music promoted by Audio Library https://youtu.be/HrXJBK_N2JA

Beach by KV https://youtube.com/c/KVmusicprod
Sun by KV https://youtube.com/c/KVmusicprod
Creative Commons — Attribution 3.0 Unported — CC BY 3.0
Free Download / Stream: https://bit.ly/3qNzbTg
Music promoted by Audio Library https://youtu.be/YPJc74M5wD4

I programmed bloons tower defense, but you're the balloon! This video covers the ninja kiwi game bloons tower defense 6, similar to SJB, Trippypepper, Tewtij, ZigZagPower and Agent Pingu. The game is made using the Unity Game Engine. this is a devlog style video. This devlog is kinda similar to videos of dani codeparade  Barji Polymars Pontypants DevDuck Goodgis sebastian lague  BWDev and other game coding youtubers.
